CustomField.description: DM-Availability | DD 13, A13-01 | Weekday of day 26 of the record's month, Hebrew (or English when Form Language = English). Empty when the month has no day 26. For the Titan form.
CustomField.formula: IF(26 > Days_In_Month__c, NULL, CASE(MOD(WEEKDAY(DATE(VALUE(Year__c), VALUE(Month__c), 1)) + 24, 7), 0, IF(ISPICKVAL(Form_Language__c, "English"), "Sunday", "ראשון"), 1, IF(ISPICKVAL(Form_Language__c, "English"), "Monday", "שני"), 2, IF(ISPICKVAL(Form_Language__c, "English"), "Tuesday", "שלישי"), 3, IF(ISPICKVAL(Form_Language__c, "English"), "Wednesday", "רביעי"), 4, IF(ISPICKVAL(Form_Language__c, "English"), "Thursday", "חמישי"), 5, IF(ISPICKVAL(Form_Language__c, "English"), "Friday", "שישי"), 6, IF(ISPICKVAL(Form_Language__c, "English"), "Saturday", "שבת"), NULL))
CustomField.label: Day 26 Weekday
